text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah! *ahem* Please forget what you just 
saw.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Taking first place is a matter of course 
for me. Victory is a prerequisite for any 
Mejiro horse girl.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So it is too early to rejoice. My mission 
has not yet been fulfilled, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, even if I get 1st place... 1st 
place... Fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Keep your voice down! Aren't you 
being a bit too overjoyed?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this is supposed to be the moment to 
brace yourself. You truly are a hopeless 
one, aren't you...♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Besides, your body won't hold out if you 
jump out of your skin every single time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I mean, isn't it obvious? Because from 
here on out, I shall continue to win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. It appears your resolve is 
the real deal as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"This victory is merely a stepping stone 
toward our next goal."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
More gorgeous, more elegant, more 
perfect... Let us rise to the very top!
